item.title: Great Bircham woman admits affray following King’s Lynn park fight
item.description:
📰 FENLAND ANGELS RADIO | LOCAL NEWS
Great Bircham woman admits affray following King’s Lynn park fight
A 29-year-old woman from Great Bircham has pleaded guilty to affray following an incident at Tower Gardens in King’s Lynn. Kirsten Skipper, of Queens Crescent, appeared at Lynn Magistrates’ Court on Thursday. The court heard that on August 10, Skipper became involved in a fight where she was seen grabbing a man’s legs, kicking him in the back, and punching him in the head.
Her solicitor stated that the altercation began after another individual rode a bike into her. The court has ordered a pre-sentence report, and Skipper has been released on conditional bail. She is prohibited from contacting the two men involved in the fight and is due to return to court on November 3.
